description.value: RE-UP BBQ is a barbecue restaurant situated on Quayside Drive in New Westminster, with a capacity of 50 and both indoor and outdoor seating. Its waterfront location makes it a potential stop for cyclists riding the Fraser River trail corridor. OSM tags indicate vegetarian options are available and the premises are wheelchair accessible.
